description: For one point in Japan: municipality and its 5-digit code, JMA warnings and advisories in force (with English names), nearest AMeDAS observation, heat (WBGT), earthquakes within 300 km, hazard zones (flood, tsunami, storm surge, landslide), elevation, nearest free RTK base, furusato-nozei prices for the municipality and the cost of living of the matching surveyed city (rent, utilities, staples; Statistics Bureau monthly survey) from kurashigram.com. Same as GET https://kuongeo.com/api/here. Warnings are relayed from JMA, not issued here.
name: here
title: Here, now (Japan)
